name: campaign-kit
description: Generates complete campaigns (image + video) from logo, references and briefing — and, with /campaign-kit:copy, copy only (PPC + overlay) from briefing + examples. Runs locally, with a technical-direction field, asset approval and piece review in the browser (regenerations show a processing indicator, the new image replaces the old one in place, an All filter keeps every piece in one grid, any rule change pops a blocking alarm + desktop notification for the user to accept or keep, and a provider failure opens a fix box to paste the key locally and copy the retry line), copy review with inline hand-editing (Edit a row and Approve to save your version), and a Visual | Copy switch between the two wizards.
